default: (a) a dungeoneer's pack or (b) an explorer's pack
An arcane focus and studded leather armor

classFeature.name: Necrotic Suffusion
entries: As an action, target a creature within 15 feet. If it's undead under your control, it regains 1d8 + CHA HP. Otherwise, it must make a CON save or take 1d8 + CHA necrotic damage.
You may use this feature a number of times equal to your CHA modifier (min. 1), regaining uses after a long rest.
The damage and healing increase to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, and 4d8 at 17th.

classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: You draw on the negative energy in the world to fuel your spells.

**Cantrips**
At 1st level, you know 2 cantrips of your choice from the Necromancer Spell List. You learn additional cantrips at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Necromancer table.

**Spell Slots**
The Necromancer table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

**Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher**
You know two 1st-level spells of your choice from the Necromancer Spell List. The Spells Known column of the Necromancer table shows when you learn more spells. Each must be a level you can cast.

**Spellcasting Ability**
Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You use it for spell save DCs and attack rolls with necromancer spells.

**Ritual Casting**
You can cast a Necromancer spell as a ritual if it has the ritual tag and you know it.

**Spellcasting Focus**
You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus for your necromancer spells.

classFeature.name: Necromancer Occult
entries: At 2nd level, choose a subclass: Keeper, Reaper, Undertaker, or Witch Doctor. Each grants features at 2nd, 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

classFeature.name: Soul Harvest
entries: When you or your undead reduce a visible hostile creature to 0 HP, use your reaction to gain temp HP equal to their CON mod + your level (min. 1).

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1. You can't raise an ability above 20 with this feature.

classFeature.name: Spontaneous Unburial
entries: You learn *animate dead*. It doesn't count against your spells known.
You can cast it as an action. You don't need a visible corpse—graves or battlefields suffice. The nearest suitable body animates and emerges automatically.

classFeature.name: Animate Major Undead
entries: You can animate a Huge or smaller humanoid, beast, or monstrosity of CR 5 or lower.
It keeps its stats (except legendary actions/spellcasting), gains undead type, and is modified depending on whether it's Skeletal or Zombified.
Skeletal: INT/WIS/CHA drop to 7, gains vulnerability to bludgeoning, darkvision 60 ft, 1 known language (can't speak), and immunity to poison damage, exhaustion, and the poisoned condition.
Zombified: INT/WIS/CHA drop to 5, gains darkvision 60 ft, 1 known language (can't speak), immunity to poison damage, exhaustion, and poisoned condition. Gains Undead Fortitude trait.
You can control 1 Major Undead at a time. Recast to reassert control. Usable once per long rest.

classFeature.name: Animate Major Undead Improvement
entries: You can now raise a CR 8 or lower giant, monstrosity, humanoid, or beast.

classFeature.name: Animate Major Undead Improvement
entries: You can now raise a CR 12 or lower aberration, dragon, giant, monstrosity, humanoid, or beast.
Your Major Undead lasts until destroyed or you animate another.

classFeature.name: Macabre
entries: You gain immunity to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, and poisoned.
You stop aging naturally. Magical aging still applies.
You have advantage on Charisma checks to influence undead. Mindless undead are indifferent unless harmed.
Undead have disadvantage on saves vs. your Necromancer spells and abilities.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1. You can't raise an ability above 20 with this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1. You can't raise an ability above 20 with this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1. You can't raise an ability above 20 with this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1. You can't raise an ability above 20 with this feature.

subclassFeature.name: Reaper Occult
entries: Reapers are precision necromancers, artists of death.

**Inevitability**
If a creature succeeds on a save or you miss with a necromancy cantrip, they still take half damage (no additional effect).
When casting necromancy spells of 1st+ level, add your proficiency bonus to one damage roll.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Soul Harvest
entries: When you have temp HP, you may reduce up to 2 × CHA modifier temp HP to increase the damage of a necromancy spell by that amount.

subclassFeature.name: Necrosis Spellcasting
entries: When you deal damage with a necromancy spell, choose one target to take +1d8 necrotic damage (or +2d8 if undead).

subclassFeature.name: Grim Aura
entries: 10 ft aura of death. Non-magical plants die in it. Creatures of your choice in it can't regain HP or stabilize.
Once per turn, use a bonus action to focus on a creature within 30 ft. CON save or be wreathed in miasma: the next necromancy spell that hits them causes vulnerability to all of its damage.
Reusable on long rest, or by expending a 4th+ level spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: Keeper Occult
entries: Necromancers of this Occult study death in order to keep it at bay. Keepers have a deep understanding of how creatures die, and how to delay or prevent it.

**Keeper Spells**
Always prepared:
2nd: *spare the dying*, *cure wounds*, *life sap*
3rd: *lesser restoration*, *aid*
5th: *aura of vitality*, *beacon of hope*
7th: *aura of life*, *aura of purity*
9th: *greater restoration*, *mass cure wounds*

**Life on Demand**
As an action, touch a willing creature. It spends 1 Hit Die and adds your CHA mod. to the roll, healing that amount (min. 1). Usable a number of times equal to your CHA mod., regains uses on long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Deliverer
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 30 ft is hit by a crit, you can reduce it to a normal hit. Effects triggered by the crit are canceled.
Usable CHA modifier times per long rest (min. 1).

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Wellbeing
entries: Undead you control that start their turn within 10 ft gain temp HP equal to 1d6 + CHA mod.
You may also grant this to any ally within 10 ft who starts their turn at half HP or less.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Mending
entries: When you heal using dice via a spell or Necromancer feature, use the max value instead of rolling.

subclassFeature.name: Witch Doctor Occult
entries: Witch Doctors draw from old traditions passed down by sages and outcasts, forging power from death.

**Spirit Well**
Touch a corpse to create a Spirit Well with a 10 ft aura. Choose a type:
- **Blindness**: CON save or blinded until end of turn
- **Hate**: Extra 1d10 necrotic damage on fail (scales with level)
- **Restrict**: DEX save or difficult terrain
- **Succor**: Half cover
- **Terror**: WIS save or frightened

Additional wells at higher levels:
6th: **Darkness**, **Silence**
10th: **Binding**, **Fatigue**
14th: **Blood**, **Fortune**, **Misfortune**
Wells expire after 1 minute or being destroyed (AC 8, 15 HP, immune to poison & psychic). You and your undead auto-succeed on saving throws from your wells. Use 2×/day, regain 1 on short rest.

subclassFeature.name: Bloodbag Army
entries: As an action, destroy one of your undead. A willing creature within 30 ft heals HP equal to the destroyed undead's current HP.
That creature gains advantage on its next attack/check/save before your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Walking Wells
entries: You can use your Spirit Well feature on one of your undead. It continues to move and act while projecting the well's aura. The undead is reduced to ash after 1 minute or when dropped to 0 HP.
Max active wells equals your proficiency bonus.

subclassFeature.name: Necrotic Pulse
entries: As a bonus action, select an active Spirit Well within 120 ft. All creatures in 30 ft of it must make a CON save or take 6d6 necrotic damage (half on success). The well is destroyed.
You may choose to expand the radius of any new well to 30 ft.

subclassFeature.name: Undertaker Occult
entries: Undertakers master the creation and command of undead, often raising massive hordes.

**Unholy Resistance**
You gain resistance to necrotic damage and immunity to max HP or ability score reduction effects.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Animation
entries: When casting *animate dead*, raise one additional undead (doesn't apply to Major Undead).
Your undead gain: +CHA to HP max, use your spell attack modifier, resistance to necrotic damage, and immunity to HP/ability score reduction.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Resolve
entries:
Undead within 30 ft:
- Immune to Turn Undead & frightened
- Attacks count as magical
- Gain CHA mod. to all saving throws

subclassFeature.name: Lord of the Undead
entries: When casting *animate dead*, you may raise a Ghoul instead of a Zombie or a Toxotai instead of a Skeleton.
